title: IED solution file v1 (<Name>.iedsln)
description: Lives at the solution root (the folder that also holds .ied/). Paths are relative to this file.

file.description: Path to a .iedproj file; globs allowed ('build/projects/*.iedproj').

optional.description: Missing file is not an error (generated projects not yet generated).

groups.description: Display grouping (VS solution folders). Nested allowed.

items.description: Loose files shown under 'Solution Items' (README, AGENTS.md, docs).

localPlugins.description: Project-local plugins; loaded only when the workspace is trusted.

id.description: Expected plugin id; mismatch with the manifest is an error.

generator.description: Who generates the project files, so IED can offer 'Regenerate' and avoid hand-editing generated files.

items.description: Files shown in this folder (workspace-relative), as VS solution folders hold files: a package's manifest.
